summary: This clinical trial compared two study drugs, orforglipron and dapagliflozin, in adults with type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar was not well controlled by metformin. Type 2 diabetes is a long-term condition that affects how the body handles blood sugar. Eli Lilly and Company sponsored this Phase 3 study, which enrolled 962 participants and is now Completed. The trial looked closely at how well each medication helped manage blood sugar levels.
